Owner: SalesTeam Updated: Aug 10, 2026 Status: Approved BROWSE VEHICLES TALK TO AN ADVISOR Buying your dream car from Japan is straightforward with CarChief. Follow our four simple steps to select, reserve, pay for, and receive your vehicle. Step 1: Select Your Vehicle Browse our stock online or request a specific model through our search and quotation form. Step 2: Reserve & Quotation Click Reserve or Request Quote to lock in vehicle availability and receive a formal Proforma Invoice. Step 3: Payment Complete wire transfer payment according to the Proforma Invoice instructions within the hold window. Step 4: Shipping & Customs Track ocean voyage progress, receive original documents via DHL, and clear the vehicle at destination port.
